items.summary:

items.title: What Happens When AI Breakthroughs Outrun Human Understanding
items.summary: OpenAI's unreleased Astra model just cracked ten open math problems that Fields Medalists would spend careers on — for about $200 each. The bigger story isn't the math. It's that almost no one alive can verify it, and we're all left asking a different AI whether the answer is real.
